Republic of the Philippines
Province of Valenzuela
City of Valenzuela
Sangguniang Panlungsod
Committee on Public Infrastructure

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING

Date: March 5, 2026
Time: 9:00 AM
Venue: Session Hall, City Hall, Valenzuela City
Reference: PH-2026-0015

SUBJECT: PROPOSED CONSTRUCTION OF THE VALENZUELA CITY GENERAL HOSPIL ANNEX BUILDING

The Committee on Public Infrastructure of the Sangguniang Panlungsod invites all interested stakeholders, sectoral representatives, non-government organizations, people's organizations, and the general public to participate in a public hearing on the above-mentioned subject.

PURPOSE:
To gather inputs, comments, and suggestions from the public regarding the proposed construction of the Valenzuela City General Hospital Annex Building, which aims to expand the hospital's capacity to serve the healthcare needs of Valenzuela City residents.

PROJECT DETAILS:
- Location: Valenzuela City General Hospital Compound, MacArthur Highway, Marulas, Valenzuela City
- Estimated Cost: ₱150,000,000.00
- Funding Source: City Government of Valenzuela (Annual Budget 2026) and Department of Health counterpart
- Project Duration: 24 months
- Proposed Building: 6-story annex building with 200-bed capacity

AGENDA:
1. Presentation of the Project Design and Scope of Work by the City Engineering Office
2. Environmental Impact Assessment Report Presentation
3. Public Comment Period
4. Open Forum

All persons and organizations wishing to submit position papers or written comments may do so by submitting the same to the Office of the City Council Secretary on or before March 1, 2026.

By order of the Committee Chairperson:

HON. FERNANDO B. CASTILLO
Committee Chair, Public Infrastructure
Sangguniang Panlungsod, Valenzuela City

Issued this 15th day of February, 2026, Valenzuela City, Philippines.
